I told Hollis the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is Gate 47. I replied in a thread on his message in #central-team: "Hollis, it's Gate 47. Pree posted Dock 23 here on Oct 14, then corrected it the same day to Gate 47 (she'd read the wrong line), so ignore Dock 23 for the account sheet."

Hollis is a member of #central-team, so both of Pree's posts there were already visible to him.
